description: Source code for configuring GPIO pins on Atmel SAM MCU family within Zephyr RTOS, including functions for setting pin attributes, input/output configuration, and peripheral connection.

methods.name: soc_gpio_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin based on provided settings, including function, pull-up/down, open drain, and input/output modes.

methods.name: soc_gpio_list_configure
methods.description: Configures a list of GPIO pins.
